name: Nightly CI

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # 02:00 UTC every day
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  cancel:
    name: Cancel Previous Runs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          all_but_latest: true

  test:
    name: Run Go Tests
    needs: cancel
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Install gotestsum
        run: |
          go install gotest.tools/gotestsum@latest
          echo "$HOME/go/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Run tests with gotestsum
        run: |
          gotestsum --junitfile test-results.xml --format standard-verbose -- ./core/...

      - name: Publish JUnit test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          files: test-results.xml
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Test summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        with:
          paths: test-results.xml
          output: test-summary.md
          show: true
          folded: false

  gates:
    name: Run Production Gates
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Start Docker Compose
        run: docker compose up -d

      - name: Run all production gates
        run: |
          # Assuming a script that runs all gates sequentially
          ./scripts/run_all_gates.sh

      - name: Stop Docker Compose
        run: docker compose down

  notify:
    name: Slack Notification
    needs: [test, gates]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Notify Slack
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          steps: ${{ toJson(steps) }}
          channel: '#ci'
          message: |
            Nightly CI finished with status **${{ job.status }}**.
            • Test job: ${{ needs.test.result }}
            • Gates job: ${{ needs.gates.result }}
